vulnerabilities.name: SQL Injection in Login Form
vulnerabilities.description: Login bypass detected using payload: ' OR '1'='1. This allows authentication bypass without valid credentials.

evidence.proof_of_concept: Use payload '' OR '1'='1' in the password/username field to bypass login

vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries and proper input validation. Never concatenate user input directly into SQL queries.

vulnerabilities.name: SQL Injection - Error-Based (Database Error Leaked)
vulnerabilities.description: SQL error leaked in response: 'syntax error'. This confirms SQL injection vulnerability.

evidence.response: {"error": "near \")\": syntax error", "query": "SELECT id, username, role, email, api_key FROM users WHERE username='admin' AND password='')'"}

vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries. Never display SQL errors to users.

vulnerabilities.name: Hardcoded Secret Exposed: Generic Secret
vulnerabilities.description: A secret of type 'Generic Secret' was found in the response body. This could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access to internal services.

evidence.proof_of_concept: The secret was found in /api/v2/users/1: AKIA1234567890ABCDEF...

vulnerabilities.remediation: Remove the hardcoded secret and use environment variables or a secrets management service.
